create_language_manager: create a LanguageManager instance to load and manage translation files for a given language code
load_language_file: load a JSON translation file from the locales directory for a specified language code
get_translation_text: get translated text from the loaded translations dictionary using a key and optional default fallback
test_language_manager: test the LanguageManager class to verify translation loading and text retrieval works correctly
review_language_manager: review the LanguageManager class and its methods for internationalization support
